messages:
ravi: Quick heads up — my former prof is swinging by at 2:30pm to set up a mini slide show with a 35mm slide projector and a small PA speaker. He'll be about 40 mins and might leave a stack of donated board games for the lounge. Can we print a temp badge and sort AV access?
frontdesk: We can print a visitor badge on arrival. Note: projectors with lamps need a stable table and ventilation  we can use the long AV cart but its in the AV closet.
av-tech: I can pull the AV cart and projector stand down. Need to know if the projector is heavy and if the speaker has a mic input.
ravi: Projector is vintage but light, uses an external lamp housing. Speaker is passive but he has a small amp. He might need one XLR cable and a power strip.
frontdesk: We'll give him access to the AV closet for setup, but AV closet is locked  need key sign-out and short disclaimer form.
av-tech: I'll meet him at the lobby at 2:25 and sign the equipment form. I'll bring spare XLR and a power extension.
badge-bot: temp badge queued: "Visitor - Prof. Anil (slide show)" expires 16:00.
lina: Seating: do we want floor pillows in the lounge or open the small meetup room for the show?
facilities: Meetup room is free 2:30-3:30. It has dimmable lights and blackout blinds if he wants darker conditions. I can set up a small table on casters for the projector.
ravi: Meetup room sounds ideal  thanks facilities. Also the donor mentioned two boxed games (Catan + Azul) and a few card games. He asked to leave them in a marked donation bin.
frontdesk: We have a small donations crate in the storage nook. We'll label it "games donation - lounge" and leave a note for inventory when someone from office ops can log it.
facilities: I'll place a crate and sticky note in the nook and meet the visitor. If anything heavy arrives, we'll use a dolly.
lina: Quick poll: tea or sparkling water for the visitor? :tea: :sparkles:
ravi: :sparkles: sparkling water please
av-tech: :tea: (tea for me)
frontdesk: We'll offer both. Reminder: if projector lamp is hot, do not touch lamp housing for 10 mins after use. We'll post a small safety sign next to the setup.
facilities: Also check that meetup room walkway is clear for the dolly and that the exit path is unobstructed.
ravi: Thanks team  I'll tell him to text when he's downstairs. Hes excited to show some slides from fieldwork  should be fun and low-key.
frontdesk: Badge will be printed on arrival, AV tech will meet him, and donation crate reserved. See you at 2:30pm."
